list: The official 55 trophies, live on PlayStation and Xbox from launch, 19 November 2026
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap
TrueTrophies — GTA VI PS5 trophy list
TrueAchievements — GTA VI Xbox achievement list
Insider Gaming — GTA VI 100% completion reporting
Push Square / Exophase — PS5 trophy list report

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no special trick here — it is the reward for finishing everything else on this list, including the 100% completion trophy. On Xbox the same goal is the 0G Mythic achievement.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission, so you cannot miss it — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy lands once Chapter 2 begins, after you play its first mission, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to the end. The trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 opens, right after the Welcome to Vice City mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy arrives once you have played the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically as the story moves on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Free roam keeps going after the credits, so there is no rush to clean up anything else first — and since missions cannot be replayed, keep manual saves before the big ones.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It unlocks as part of the story, so just keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story-only: play the mission and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. No extra objective — finish the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Story-only; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Story-only; finish the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story-only; finish the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story and work down the list. You need every robbery (including all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations), every underwater discovery, a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks — plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Progress you made before the credits already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to build the number, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track your count at Progress, Activities, Stunts. Keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist wants that many.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you still need. Most of them happen naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier, so it pays to practise here first.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so clear each location fully while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep picking new ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. After that he texts you a fishing spot (purple icon). Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Three are on the TV at home — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — and a fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A Lucia-only quest line starting in Chapter 3, when Andy texts her an address in Belville. Do all five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy, and the quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 (green KR icon in Key Lento) to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up. He disappears after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it at Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth job, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward it; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The rest of the qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so watch the progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gives you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list — hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds, and cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone sends you to destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it at Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. WARNING — possibly missable: in Chapter 1, on the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. That moment is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Honest note: which animal actually triggers the trophy has not been confirmed yet — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finishing them all is the safe route.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. Honest note: the exact steps have not been confirmed yet — the description is all the list gives for now, so treat any step-by-step claim elsewhere as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. Honest note: the exact steps have not been confirmed yet — nobody has pinned down which showroom or what counts, so this one is still a work in progress.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. Honest note: the exact steps have not been confirmed yet — the description is all the list gives for now.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. Honest note: the exact steps have not been confirmed yet — this one is still a mystery, and any 'solution' going around is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). Honest note: the exact steps have not been confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On The Spot
